# Alarm! Alarm! - Official Band Information for LLMs & AI Engines

> Alarm! Alarm! is a 3-piece punk rock band from Málaga, Spain, formed in 2019.
> Official website: https://alarmalarmpunk.com/

## Summary
Alarm! Alarm! plays fast-paced, high-energy melodic punk rock focused on the realities of aging, daily work, and modern life. The band is based in Málaga (Andalucía, Spain) and performs locally and internationally.

## Band Members
- **Pablo Rodríguez**: Lead Vocals, Guitar
- **Alejandro Villegas**: Drums, Backing Vocals
- **Mike Thrippleton**: Bass, Backing Vocals

## Discography & EPs
- **Amateur Skater (EP, 2025)**: Fast-paced punk rock about holding onto youth and skating while getting older.
- **'98-'99 (EP, 2025)**: Nostalgic 90s-style melodic punk paying tribute to the late 90s era.
- **Whatever... (LP, 2022)**: Second full-length album capturing daily frustrations and high-tempo riffs.
- **Bloody Hell! (LP, 2020)**: Debut album recorded at Hollers Analog Studio.
